newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta call money declines to six percent.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta call money declines to six percent.

text.p: Jakarta call money eased down to six percent at mid-morning on Tuesday from 10.0/11.0 percent on some excess supply, dealers said.
Bank Indonesia supplied 582 billion rupiah into the market.
Dealers said trading was slow, with operators seen looking for rupiah maturing after April 16 when the new bank reserve rate of five percent will be effective.
Dealers estimated that between five and eight trillion rupiah will be drained from the market to meet the new rate.
